note_text:
CC: follow up plantar fasciitis

HPI: weeks of symptoms relating to extensive callus burden with pain on ambulation.

Exam: plantar callus area consistent with extensive callus burden with pain on ambulation; general inspection of the foot otherwise unremarkable.

MDM: discussed risks and benefits of the planned procedure; patient consents. Mentioned other complaints, no separate management plan.

Procedure: Paring of extensive hyperkeratotic lesions performed. Tolerated well, no immediate complications.
